title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台
summary: 從iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一模態、局部近似與假想群折射率；未包含耦合器相位色散、溫度漂移及實際製程分布。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single mode, local approximation and hypothetical group index; coupler phase dispersion, thermal drift and process distributions are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
